settle.label: Settling
settle.line: {name} was talked into settling early. ${price}, and a firm tone of voice.

vat.label: Gestation
vat.line: The vat was told to hurry. ${price}, and it complied with a noise nobody wants to hear twice.

resequencer.label: Resequencing
resequencer.line: The tank skipped to the end of {name}. ${price}; the sample did not notice.

egg.label: Incubation
egg.line: {name} was kept a little too warm. ${price}. It hatches when you say so.

kinds.refusal: That clock is not for sale. The waiting is the part that makes the thing worth having.
